description: The single-setting residual \(R_{p,b}(\Gamma)\) is exactly the residual under the partial assignment assigning only \(p=b\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting_residual.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (p : α) (b : Bool)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Cnf α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p b Γ =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.residual
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.single p b) Γ
